rule: Sustained-Red window is the last 5 days (today + 4 prior)
summary: A coaching heuristic paired with sustained_red_days (3 of 5): long enough to catch a run of poor days, short enough to act within a week. Overreaching studies show measurable fatigue after 1-3 weeks of overload and weekly averages detect it better than isolated days, consistent with a window of about a week, but no source tests 5 days specifically.

sources.note: Overreaching developed over 3 weeks of overload; weekly HRV means detected it while isolated days did not
Signal plateaus with 3-4 valid days per week, roughly what 3 of 5 requires
